name: Reggaeton sub tresillo
desc: Modern perreo sub-bass: a round FM sine pulsing the 3+3+2 tresillo (notes on the 1, 4 and 7 of the sixteenth grid), the last held on a long release as an anticipation into the downbeat, walking an i-VI-iv-V root progression in G minor that turns each cycle. Dark and clubby; full adds octave pops, peak runs quick approach notes.

code.sparse: note("<[g1 ~ ~ g1 ~ ~ g1 ~] [c2 ~ ~ c2 ~ ~ c2 ~] [eb1 ~ ~ eb1 ~ ~ eb1 ~] [d2 ~ ~ d2 ~ ~ d2 ~]>").add(note(${root})).s("sine").fm(${fm}).fmh(2).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7, ${cut}*1.2).slow(16)).attack(.01).decay(.35).sustain(.55).release(.28).shape(.2).gain(${gain}*.9).room(.1).orbit(3).play()
code.full: note("<[g1 ~ ~ g2 ~ ~ d2 ~] [c2 ~ ~ c3 ~ ~ g2 ~] [eb1 ~ ~ eb2 ~ ~ bb1 ~] [d2 ~ ~ d3 ~ ~ a1 ~]>").add(note(${root})).s("sine").fm(${fm}).fmh(2).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7, ${cut}*1.4).slow(16)).attack(.008).decay(.35).sustain(.55).release(.28).shape(.25).gain(${gain}).room(.1).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: note("<[g1 g2 ~ g1 bb1 ~ d2 ~] [c2 c3 ~ c2 eb2 ~ g2 ~] [eb1 eb2 ~ eb1 g1 ~ bb1 ~] [d2 d3 ~ d2 f2 ~ a1 ~]>").add(note(${root})).s("sine").fm(${fm}).fmh(2).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.9, ${cut}*1.8).slow(8)).attack(.006).decay(.3).sustain(.5).release(.24).shape(.3).gain(${gain}).room(.1).lastOf(4, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(3).play()
